note: USACE campground on a point in Stockton Lake east of Stockton. Sites A31-A34 at the tip of the point open straight onto the shore; the rest sit in oak woods, the B loop inside a road loop. --Claude
summary: rec.gov read: 55 sites (32 at 30-amp, 23 non-electric), lengths 20-50 ft, showers/flush/dump, reservable Mar 15 - Nov 30, peak $20/$28 (A37 $40), off-peak $10/$20. Lakefront kept on A31-A34 only. Pin is the facility point across the cove: move to the A loop. Phone 417-276-6799 to add. Season: stored year_round (from note prose) vs no calendar Dec-Mar 14 - flagged.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, kept on A31-A34). On the 0.24 m/px leaf-off frame, A31, A32, A33 and A34 are gravel back-in pads on the east side of the loop road at the tip of the point; their aprons run straight onto the open sandy shore ~15-20 m away, with no road, lot or lawn between (the loop road is behind them). The frame is at low winter water, so the water itself was ~80 m off across bare lakebed; at normal pool the shoreline is at the edge of that sand band. A35 and A29 sit in trees ~35 m above a rocky shore on the west side; A20-A30 along the east road face the cove across the road and a wide beach; the rest of the A loop is in woods ~50 m+ back. The B loop sits inside a road loop with the road between it and the water. No rec.gov site photo was checked; if A31-A34 are judged too far back at normal pool, lakeview is the fallback.

PIN: stored 37.6697,-93.7531 = the rec.gov facility point, ~350 m E across the cove from the campground (by a road/lot on the far shore). Suggest moving to the A loop at 37.6688,-93.7576 (the loop junction by A12).
PHONE: rec.gov lists 417-276-6799 (park) and 417-276-3113 (project office). The entry has no phone; add 417-276-6799 by hand (apply.py doesn't write phones).

SEASON (stored year_round true, derived from note prose; left alone): rec.gov never says year round. Its calendar has no campsite data Dec 1 - Mar 14, and the notices name shoulder seasons Mar 15 - Apr 15 and Oct 1 - Nov 30. Whether the park stays open without reservations in winter isn't stated. booking.season 03-15 to 11-30 written. AWH: change season to 03-15..11-30 if winter means closed.
SITES: the description says 58 campsites; the catalog has 55, which is what was written. max_rig_ft 50 = A28 (reservable, 30-amp). B02, B08, B09 and A36/A40/A41 are listed at 20-30 ft.
WATER HOOKUP not written: no site lists one; the notice 'Drinking water and electric hookups are available during the reservation season' means spigots, not hookups.
Note rewritten: which sites earn the lake value; season, amps, loop counts and booking are now in the fields.
